name: Anthropic
description: AI safety company building Claude. Monitor organization member access, API availability, and sync employees from Anthropic.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Go to console.anthropic.com and sign in as an Organization Admin
2. Navigate to Settings > Admin keys
3. Create a new Admin API key (it will start with sk-ant-admin01-)
4. Copy the key and enter it above
5. Note: Only Admin API keys can list organization members and manage access. Regular API keys will not work for employee access checks.

checks.name: Anthropic App Availability
checks.description: Checks that the Anthropic API is accessible with the provided credentials.

checks.name: Anthropic Employee Access
checks.description: Lists all Anthropic organization members with their email, role, and access details for Access Review evidence.
